Product Owner Crypto - Assistant Vice President
Purchase, New York

Company Profile:

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm’s employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence, and strong ethics. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives, and needs is an important part of our culture.

Department Overview

In the Wealth Management division, we help people, businesses and institutions build, preserve, and manage wealth so they can pursue their financial goals.
Wealth Management (WM) Platforms manages industry-leading platforms, across all WM channels and client segments, to provide a unified digital experience, unlock growth, and deliver efficiencies for Advisors, Clients, and Institutions. WM Platforms consists of ten sub-teams including: Digital Trading & Investing, Field Experience & Platforms, Digital Client Experience & Platforms, Workplace Platforms, Automation & Workflow, Generative AI, UX Design & Research, Strategy & Execution, WM Platforms Risk, and the Chief Operating Office.

Responsibilities

Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated product owner to influence, define and execute the digital roadmap for E*TRADE Trading & Investing, with a specific focus on the markets and research offering, including cryptocurrency. The ideal candidate is someone who has a passion for the markets and a demonstrated interest in product management, preferably in financial services. Strong domain knowledge of trading and investing products including stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, cryptocurrencies & options (fixed income knowledge a plus). Communication is essential for success in this role.

This position will be responsible for writing user stories, maintaining an Agile backlog, and assisting with sprint planning, testing, & releases for the E*TRADE and MS Online websites. Candidates must be highly motivated, detail-oriented, and customer-focused with strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Championing the online markets and research experience for E*TRADE from Morgan Stanley and Wealth Management clients across platforms, identifying opportunities for feature enhancements and projects, executing against the strategic roadmap and ensuring UX is free of friction or issues.
Execute the unified digital platform roadmap for markets, with an emphasis on bridging research and key experience gaps across platforms.
Forge continued integration and feature delivery aligning with key research stakeholders in WM and ISG business and technology.
Lead all day-to-day operation and support activities withing product internally and with key vendor relationship including issue escalation, managing client feedback, backlog grooming and prioritization, troubleshooting, release management, as well as communication and status updates to keep all stakeholders informed and to set expectations for clients.
Work closely with technology and 3rd party vendors to support and drive requirements for crypto market data integration and asset custodianship.
Help develop, test and manage AI features and capabilities within the E*Trade Trading & Investing team, working closely with control partners and within the overall AI governance processes.
Maintain and prioritize product backlog creating user stories and epics with detailed acceptance criteria for feature development as well as provide support for production issues and resolution.
Actively participate in product validation / testing with QA and help oversee release management process.
Participate and lead Agile/Scrum ceremonies including stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, demos and retrospectives.
Collaborate with various stakeholders throughout the organization and externally to drive project delivery and execution including UX & Design, Technology, QA, Service, Operations, Legal, Risk, Compliance and 3rd party vendors.
Work quickly and effectively to resolve client-facing issues or concerns.
Prepare presentations to communicate ideas, gain stakeholder approvals, report project statuses, measure & track KPIs.
Monitor and maintain products through their lifecycle: launch, growth, maturity and decline.
Maintain awareness of industry trends, compliance concerns, risk control processes, and regulatory landscape.
Acquire a robust understanding of E*TRADE products, services, processes, and organizational structure in order to find optimal solutions and achieve rapid execution of key initiatives.

Requirements

Education + Experience Required

Minimum 5 years of agile product management experience, preferably in financial services.
Experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst, owning and delivering enterprise-scale digital products within a financial regulatory environment.
Direct experience working with multiple key stakeholders in cross-functional teams.
Experience in analyzing user feedback, backlog grooming and prioritization, pilot testing and rollout strategy, communication plans, overall product support, and driving technology adoption strategies.

Skills Required

Prior experience related to markets, equities research and cryptocurrency trading preferred.
Proficiency in leveraging AI tools for efficiency and completing tasks.
Understanding of competitive and regulatory environments for online brokerages (web, mobile, desktop app)
Ability to effectively and thoughtfully communicate to a wide range of stakeholders (verbal and written)
Strong analytical, problem solving, organizational and project management skills.
Self-starter with curiosity and desire to dig into and understand details.
Comfortable gathering and utilizing data analytics, usage and internal and external feedback to inform decision-making.
Proven ability to manage competing priorities and initiatives / parallel work tracks.
Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint and other Microsoft Office applications
Basic familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, and Asana as product / project management tools
Additional product or project management certifications a plus
Knowledge of E*TRADE products, services, & systems a plus

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

added.description:
At Early Warning, we’ve powered and protected the U.S. financial system for over thirty years with cutting-edge solutions like Zelle®, Paze®, and so much more. As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses.

Positions located in Scottsdale, San Francisco, Chicago, or New York follow a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment.

Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship.

Overall Purpose

The Senior Lead Product Manager is the champion responsible for evaluating and determining the product(s) and/or features to be built and delivered to our customers. The role will build, align, and motivate a cross functional team to develop a common understanding of the customers’ pain points and the passion to solve issues and develop innovative solutions that delight customers. The role may lead multiple products.

Essential Functions

Visionary and Strategist: Builds the right cross-functional team to obtain a common understanding of customer pain points, empathy and excitement for solving customer issues and driving product revenue. Articulates product strategy and vision across the enterprise across multiple products.
Customer Passion and Advocacy: Brings the customer viewpoint to the product design process with a demonstrated competency to actively listen to customer feedback across all touchpoints and channels; to routinely leverage this feedback into insights; and to build products and services that delight and inspire.
Creative Problem Solver: Works closely with marketing, research, analytics, design and development partners, uses technical savvy and customer insights to develop real world solutions working in a highly collaborative environment. Uses insights about the market and industry to drive development of value-added solutions for customers.
Commitment to Risk Management: Oversees the integration of strong risk and security controls. Ensures compliance to laws and regulations.
Technical Understanding: Able and adept at working directly with the technologists to deliver market solutions. Clearly defines requirements, grooms user stories, motivates technical teams and partners with technology closely

Area of Specialty: Money Movement

Define and execute new money movement use cases for Zelle that deliver differentiated experiences for relevant users – consumers, financial institutions, merchants, etc
Partner with relevant participants in the payments ecosystem – financial institutions, merchants, networks, and strategic advisors – to shape product direction and validate market opportunities
Lead product discovery by translating customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence into innovative money movement experiences and product requirements
Define money movement experiences that optimize frictionless completion, trust, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction across digital channels
Collaborate with Engineering, Design, Risk, Fraud, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Operations to deliver scalable, secure, and customer-centric money movement solutions
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept and business case through requirements, pilot execution, commercialization, and General Availability
Define success metrics and monitor product performance, including adoption, payment lifecycle, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and business growth

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of product management experience in payments, fintech, commerce, or related industries
Proven experience taking products from idea to launch
Deep understanding of money movement across multiple disciplines – P2P, A2A, bill payment and e-commerce
Strong customer discovery, product strategy, and roadmap development skills
Experience influencing and leading cross-functional teams without direct authority
Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and create clarity for teams and stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at similar money movement platforms
Experience building money movement products across multiple domains
Familiarity with digital wallets, embedded payments, alternative payment methods, real-time payments, or emerging commerce experiences
Experience launching pilot programs and scaling products to General Availability

added.description:
About Savvy Wealth

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.

Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.

AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!

Recognition

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)
Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)
Great Place to Work Certified™

The Role

The Senior Product Manager role is a high-impact role, you will operate in a very dynamic environment where you’ll get to proactively identify market opportunities across the business and lead the product direction & strategy to tackle them.

You will play a critical role in identifying market opportunities to expand value to existing customers and build new product lines. In doing so, you will be responsible for determining which products we should build next, the scope of each product surface area, what metrics we should drive towards, and more. You will also be responsible for leading projects from inception to production while partnering closely with engineering, design, and cross functional business partners to drive strong and rapid execution.

There’s an endless amount of opportunity that we can be pursuing; yet the ability to focus and place our bets on a few highly impactful areas is how we’ll continue to win. You’ll hold the mantle in determining what those bets are and then relentlessly drive towards the finish line on a high velocity team.

In order to succeed in this role, the right candidate should be adept at navigating an ambiguous and fast-paced environment with limited guidance. You’d be a great fit if you aspire to be a future organization leader or founder.

Responsibilities

Identify the best market opportunities for the business to pursue and create a compelling product vision & strategy around pursuing the opportunities.
Determine and articulate the actionable plan that will incrementally improve the product towards the product vision.
Build and continuously update the roadmap with a clear prioritization framework and rationale to meet the goals set out.
Research the market, customer, and the customer’s problem by keeping up to date on industry news & trends, participating in user research and discovery calls, collaborating on customer surveys, and synthesizing the firehose of customer feedback.
Write product specifications for everyone to align on the problem to be solved, goal(s), scope of work, success metrics, project plan, and other relevant information to help engineers, designers, and cross-functional team members develop the product.
Own projects on the roadmap end-to-end to ship high-quality products for our customers.
Work with engineers and designers to drive projects to completion, unblocking any issues that come up along the way.
Come up with the right messaging for products for each relevant audience (end customer, marketing, sales, etc.)
Evaluate whether products have been successful in achieving their goals using metrics and feedback.
Leverage non-software solutions (e.g., third parties, manual processes) whenever necessary to get the job done.
Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment to ensure everyone is educated on the latest product developments.

Must Have

5+ years of product management experience.
2+ years of experience at a high growth tech startup.
Experience working with engineers and designers in developing B2B software products.
Led at least one successful product/business line at a high growth tech startup.
Strong business, design, and technical sense.
Strong experience using various AI tools in your workflow (Cursor, Claude, Claude Code, etc.)

Nice To Have

Experience working at B2B fintech tech, technology-driven financial services, and/or wealth management technology companies.
Stood up a new product line or services business from zero.
Experience evaluating, negotiating with, and building relationships with vendors.
Experience with RIAs and/or broker-dealers and their compliance rules.
Previously a founder, or thinking about becoming one.
BS/MS in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity package
Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays
Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans
Company 401(k), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans
NYC office in the heart of Manhattan
Lunch and snacks provided in the office
Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care
Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

Compensation Range: $190K - $225K

added.description:
Uncommon Schools is a nonprofit network of high-performing public charter schools dedicated to providing an exceptional K-12 education in economically disadvantaged communities. Operating in Boston, Camden, New York City, Newark, and Rochester, we are committed to closing the college completion gap and preparing every student for college and beyond. Our students consistently exceed national benchmarks
, reflecting our dedication to their success. We invest deeply in our educators
, offering weekly coaching, feedback, and professional development to ensure excellence in teaching and leadership. Join us to work hard, do good, and make a lasting difference!

Job Description

The Senior Product Manager, Salesforce serves as the lead technical expert and strategic thought partner for Uncommon Schools’ Salesforce platforms. Sitting within the Data & IT team, this role translates organizational priorities into a clear technical roadmap that supports critical enrollment, marketing, operational, and financial goals. By bridging technical execution with strategic planning, you will ensure our CRM platform delivers high-value capabilities and seamless user experiences across central teams and schools. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional leaders, manage system architecture and data flows, and partner with technology vendors to optimize enterprise systems that directly support our mission.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Execution

Set and champion the technical vision and roadmap for all Salesforce instances (including Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Service Cloud) aligned with organizational goals and enrollment constraints.

Evaluate build, buy, consolidate, and retire decisions across the CRM portfolio and present investment cases to non-technical senior stakeholders.

Identify new platform enhancement opportunities, including automation workflows within Marketing Cloud.

Drive system roadmaps and maintenance strategies, managing upgrades, testing, backups, and integrations with enterprise applications.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives, and 8-to-12-week Planning Increment sessions.

Lead cross-functional problem-solving for complex technical projects involving multiple vendors, internal software systems, and data warehouses.

Build and maintain collaborative cross-functional communities, facilitating communication to break down functional silos.

Partner with Business Process Owners, Regional Superintendents, Chiefs of Staff, and School Operations Leaders to design effective system processes and workflows.

Data Governance & System Architecture

Define and maintain data flows, system-of-record boundaries, and data handoffs between Salesforce and other core enterprise systems (e.g., student information systems, enrollment tools).

Partner with System Architects, Data Architects, and Data Governance teams to establish record ownership, access levels, retention rules, and standard data dictionaries.

Drive data quality across the portfolio, managing data cleansing efforts and removing technical debt.

Ensure all CRM capabilities comply with enterprise cybersecurity guidelines, family data privacy requirements, and artificial intelligence usage guidelines.

Operations & Enablement

Manage day-to-day platform administration, establishing policies for user access, security roles, system usage, and reporting.

Manage vendor contracts, renewal processes, and tier-3 support escalations to ensure high performance.

Design and deliver train-the-trainer sessions and training programs for business process owners, school leaders, and service desk staff.

Develop and maintain centralized Knowledge Base articles and documentation covering system processes, troubleshooting, and best practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

5–6 years of relevant experience in Salesforce product management, system administration, or technical project implementation.

Hands-on experience working across Salesforce products, including Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Service Cloud.

Experience leading Agile processes, managing project backlogs, and executing multi-stakeholder technical plans.

Demonstrated ability to design business processes, troubleshoot complex technical root causes, and manage platform governance.

Strong communication skills with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of experience within a K–12, higher education, or EdTech environment.

1+ year of experience building prompt-based tools leveraging large language models (LLMs).

Working knowledge of help desk ticketing software (e.g., Zendesk).

Physical Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk and working on a computer.

Not sure if you meet every qualification? We encourage you to apply—we're excited to learn what you bring.

Our people are what make us Uncommon.
We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support the personal health, wellness, and finances of our staff and their families. Our compensation philosophy values equity & fairness and attracting & retaining top talent.

Compensation

Typically, new hires who fully meet the qualifications and experience expectations for the role will start at or near $124,300.

Starting compensation below this reflects candidates with less experience or qualifications. Offers near the top end of the range are reserved for candidates who significantly exceed the qualifications, bringing extensive experience and specialized expertise beyond what is listed.

Candidates must be based in the NYC or Newark region and be required to travel monthly to regional locations (such as Rochester, Boston, or Camden) for 2 to 3 days at a time.

added.description:
About Stepful

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our Values

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

Care first: We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.
Learn quickly: We test, learn with data, and iterate.
Build together: We win when we rely on each other.
Own it: We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The Opportunity

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This role reports directly to the Senior Director, Product Management and partners closely with the Student Experience team, including student success coaches, instructors, and career services, as well as design, engineering, data, and marketing.

This is a hybrid opportunity based out of our NYC office, requiring three days/week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday) in office.

What You'll Do

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the end-to-end student experience for both our D2C and B2B2C business, from onboarding and live instruction through graduation.
Challenge long-held assumptions about how students learn and progress, and bring bold, evidence-backed ideas for improving completion, certification pass rates, and job outcomes.
Partner closely with the Student Experience team to understand where students get stuck, and decide what should be solved with product, with process, or with people.
Talk to students regularly through interviews, usability sessions, and feedback loops so their real needs shape what we build.
Run a disciplined experimentation program with A/B tests and rapid prototypes to learn quickly and scale what works.
Collaborate with designers and engineers to ship intuitive, mobile-friendly experiences for learners who are often studying on the go.
Use AI and automation to deliver more personal support at scale, so tech empowers our coaches and instructors instead of replacing them.
Define and track success metrics tied to student engagement, retention, completion, satisfaction (NPS), and job placement. We're not a feature factory and have no intention of becoming one!

What You'll Bring

7+ years of product management experience, with a strong track record building consumer-facing products
Proven success moving engagement, retention, or conversion metrics for a large user base, with launches you can point to
Strong product fundamentals: structured discovery, hypothesis-driven experimentation, focused prioritization, roadmap ownership, and clear documentation
A deep, genuine obsession with users, and comfort turning qualitative insights and messy data into clear product decisions
Comfort working with complex data sets and writing SQL to generate your own insights
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to earn trust quickly with operators, instructors, execs, and technical teams
The ability to clearly articulate tradeoffs, make decisions with imperfect information, and find the 80/20 quickly
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including crafting narratives that drive alignment and action

Bonus Points If

You've built products in EdTech, healthcare, workforce development, or another mission-driven industry
You've designed experiences for adult learners, career changers, or underserved populations
You've built products that blend self-serve software with human support, such as coaching, tutoring, or customer success

About Viz.ai

Viz.ai is the leader in building and deploying AI-powered Care Pathways and helping doctors do their work. The Viz Platform is deployed in 2,000 hospitals across the United States and trusted by many of the leading life sciences companies. The platform uniquely combines real-time, multimodal clinical data with deep clinician engagement to detect disease earlier, coordinate care teams, and help ensure patients receive the right treatment faster. Viz.ai was the first company to be awarded CMS reimbursement for AI and is ranked the #1 Healthcare AI Platform by hospitals and health systems in the Black Book Research survey. For more information, visit Viz.ai.

The Role

We're looking for an exceptional Director or Senior Director of Product to define, build, and scale the next generation of oncology products at Viz.ai — a role at the intersection of oncology, product, commercial strategy, AI, and customer experience. We're looking for someone who deeply understands the oncology ecosystem and can translate unmet needs into products that clinicians love, customers buy, and that ultimately help more patients access lifesaving treatments.

You'll operate at multiple altitudes: understanding the oncology market, engaging leading KOLs and customers, defining product strategy, writing detailed PRDs, rapidly prototyping new experiences, and partnering with engineering, design, product marketing, sales, clinical, and Inbound Product Management to get products into clinicians' hands. The ideal candidate combines the market instinct of a commercial leader, the customer obsession of a great product manager, and the execution rigor of a product builder.

What You'll Own

Define the Oncology Product Strategy

Build a differentiated oncology product strategy grounded in customer needs, market opportunity, competitive dynamics, and Viz's unique strengths — informed by deep, ongoing relationships with oncology KOLs, clinicians, and health-system leaders.
Identify unmet needs and market gaps where technology can meaningfully improve patient care and create commercial value, and translate them into business cases that help leadership prioritize investment.
Spend significant time directly with customers and users, and maintain a current view of competitors, emerging technology, and evolving oncology care models.

Build Products People Actually Use

Own products end-to-end — from insight and concept through requirements, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization — writing PRDs that clearly connect the user problem, requirements, and business rationale.
Partner with Design, Engineering, and Inbound Product Management to build products that are intuitive and clinically meaningful, and that stay consistent with the broader Viz platform.
Use modern AI-native and agentic tools (eg. Figma Make, Claude Code, Claude Design) to test ideas directly with customers before committing engineering resources.

Drive Go-to-Market in Partnership with BD, Commercial & Clinical

Partner with BD, Commercial, Sales, and Product Marketing to build go-to-market strategy, articulate value proposition and positioning, and identify lighthouse customers and design partners — this is joint ownership, not a solo mandate.
Partner with Clinical and the Chief Medical Officer to make sure go-to-market claims and positioning are clinically sound.
Define and monitor metrics across adoption, engagement, customer value, commercial performance, and patient impact.

8+ years of oncology-adjacent healthcare experience (clinical, commercial, diagnostics, or life sciences), with a sophisticated understanding of the oncology ecosystem and clinical workflows.
5+ years of product management experience building and launching complex healthcare, software, AI, or technology products.
A highly commercial mindset — comfortable sizing markets, understanding buyers, and connecting product decisions to revenue and growth, working in true partnership with BD and Commercial rather than owning commercial strategy solo.
Strong relationships within the oncology ecosystem, or a demonstrated ability to rapidly build credibility with leading clinicians and KOLs.
Strong understanding of modern AI products and real enthusiasm for agentic, AI-native development — comfortable prototyping your own ideas rather than only spec'ing them for someone else.
Excellent written and verbal communication, able to move fluidly between clinicians, engineers, commercial teams, executives, and customers.
Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, in areas with no established playbook.

Bonus Qualifications

Oncology clinical licensure (MD, APP/PA/NP, or RN with oncology specialization) a plus, but not required.
Experience with oncology-specific EHR or workflow systems (e.g., Epic Beacon, iKnowMed, ARIA).
Experience with life sciences or pharma partnership models in oncology.
Advanced degree (MD, MBA, or MPH) a plus, but not required.

We believe great healthcare products start with the patient but succeed by deeply understanding the people responsible for delivering their care. We're looking for someone who is obsessive about engagement — it isn't enough to build something technically impressive; it has to fit naturally into clinical workflows and be good enough that clinicians actively want to use it.

The strongest candidates move seamlessly between conversations — from an oncologist explaining where a workflow breaks down, to a customer explaining why solving it matters, to a BD or Clinical partner shaping the go-to-market plan together, to a leadership team hearing the business case for why we should invest.

This is an opportunity to build first-of-kind products in an environment where the answers don't already exist. Above all, you should be motivated by our mission to increase access to lifesaving treatments and build products that meaningfully improve care for people with cancer.

Why should you join us?

If you are looking to make an impact, we are mission-driven and are making a difference in peoples’ lives every day.
If you want to be a part of an amazing team , our people are the heart of everything we do.
If you are a self-starter and naturally motivated, our work is driven by curiosity, innovation and team collaboration which allows us to leverage our skills immeasurably.

We are a remote-first company across the U.S. and EU, with a team in Tel Aviv operating in a flexible hybrid model, conveniently located near a train line.

We are looking for a Vice President, Product Management to lead product strategy, product planning, roadmap development, and cross-functional product execution across the organization.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for defining product priorities, translating business and customer needs into product strategies, and building a disciplined product management function. The VP, Product Management will oversee product planning, requirements, prioritization, lifecycle management, performance measurement, and coordination across Product, Technology, Operations, Design, Compliance, and other functions.

You will work closely with executive leadership and leaders across Technology, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Finance, Risk, Compliance, and Customer Operations. The role will ensure that product decisions are aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, operational capabilities, and long-term organizational priorities.

Because the organization is continuing to build and scale, this role will have significant influence over product management processes, roadmap development, product governance, prioritization frameworks, and the structure of the product organization.
